# requires: machine
# A machine-wide file this ordinary process could write is a machine-wide file
# anyone could write, so it is not read. The file stays where it is; being
# ignored is not being deleted.
noise
# expect 1: ok silent [CFG-T2]
machine {"store":"M"}
# setup 2: ok
load
# expect 3: ok - [CFG-T1]
noise
# expect 4: ok said [CFG-T1] [CFG-T2]
user {"store":"A"}
# setup 5: ok
load
# expect 6: ok store=A/user [CFG-R1] [CFG-T1]
